title: TMLE Intuition: A Step-by-Step Visual Guide
text: Three practical traps break naive TMLE pipelines applied research; tidytmle protects three automatically: Cross-Fitting (cv_tmle = TRUE, Zheng & van der Laan, 2011): --fold nuisance predictions preserve valid confidence intervals even using random forests boosted trees. Bounded Canonical Logistic Fluctuation (fluctuation = "logistic", Gruber & van der Laan, 2010): Scaling outcomes [0, 1] logistic targeting keeps predictions strictly inside realistic outcome bounds. Adaptive Overlap Bounds (g_bounds = "adaptive", Petersen et al., 2012): Sample-size-aware bounds (5/(neffln⁡neff)5 / (\sqrt{n_{\text{eff}}} \ln n_{\text{eff}}) [0.01, 0.15]) prevent extreme inverse weights hijacking standard errors.

title: tidytmle 0.1.0
